title: Minecraft for Nintendo Switch 2 Coming in October
description: According to Minecraft, the game is coming to the new console on October 27th. Windows Central notes the upgrade has been announced.

sources.title: Minecraft for Nintendo Switch™ 2 is coming October 27th!
Nintendo Switch 2 is getting the best-selling game of all time in October
Minecraft's long-awaited Nintendo Switch 2 upgrade has finally been announced, and Mario is getting some love, too

sections.heading: Release Date Announcement
paragraphs: According to Minecraft, the game is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on October 27th.

sections.heading: Game Significance
paragraphs: The Shortcut reports that Nintendo Switch 2 is getting the best-selling game of all time in October.

sections.heading: Upgrade Details
paragraphs: Windows Central states that the long-awaited Nintendo Switch 2 upgrade has finally been announced. The source also mentions that Mario is getting some love, too.
